column49: Dhokra is one of the oldest surviving metal-casting traditions in the world, practiced continuously for over 4,000 years. The technique uses no moulds that can be reused — once the clay shell is broken to release the piece, that exact form can never be recreated. Your purchase directly funds a family-run workshop in Kondagaon and helps pass the craft to the next generation.
